name: Father In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals God as the singular Father in heaven, emphasizing that believers should recognize no earthly father with the same reverence as Him, for He alone holds that divine role (Matthew 23:9). In prayer, believers are taught to address God as 'Our Father which art in heaven,' acknowledging His holiness and sovereign will (Luke 11:2), and are called to forgive others so that their heavenly Father may also forgive their trespasses (Mark 11:25). Ultimately, the Father in heaven offers the gift of eternal life through Jesus Christ, contrasting the death that sin wages (Romans 6:23).
